messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "call doctor right away if become pregnant while taking"
set: ["call doctor right away if become pregnant while taking", "tell doctor if become pregnant while taking", "tell doctor if become pregnant while taking this medicine", "stop taking and tell doctor right away if pregnant", "stop taking and call doctor right away", "tell doctor if pregnant or planning to become pregnant", "call doctor right away if you have weakness", "tell doctor if plan to become pregnant", "tell healthcare provider if pregnant, become pregnant, or plan to become pregnant while taking fluoxetine tablets", "tell doctor straight away if pregnant", "call doctor right away if serious side effects occur", "call your doctor right away if you experience agitation", "call your doctor right away if you have tenderness", "call doctor right away if you have dark urine", "follow doctor's instructions if pregnant or become pregnant", "call your doctor right away if you experience extreme worry"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set

}
